FAQs
What is Studley AI?
+

Studley AI is the ultimate studying platform that turns any docs, lecture recordings, youtube videos, articles, and text input into insane, high quality, and editable Flashcards, Quizzes, Written Tests, Tutor Lessons, Fill in the Blanks and Audio Podcasts. You can also get instant answers from any photo on our mobile app!

What is the difference between the free and unlimited?
+

The Free plan allows you to make one study set to show you the value of Studley. The Unlimited plan gives you full access to all features with no restrictions. You can either pay $3.74/week (billed monthly) or $1.88/week (billed annually).

Why was Studley AI founded?
+

There are thousands of study sites out there, but they are always missing something. Whether it be a feature, intuitive design, or too costly. Studley AI solves all of these issues by providing everything you need in one place. There is also a massive mismatch between how we study and how the brain naturally learns. Reading textbooks and watching hour-long lecture videos isn't effective. Making study materials from scratch is tedious. Studley AI gets you studying in seconds & is engaging, fast, and scientifically proven to be effective.

Can Studley AI be used to replace human tutoring?
+

Yes. Who needs to pay for an overpriced tutor when you can get the same results with Studley AI for basically nothing. Not to mention, Studley AI is a lot more engaging and effective than a human tutor.

Can I make money promoting Studley AI?
+

Yes! We will pay you a weekly retainer plus a bonus if any of your videos go viral 😁. All you have to do is post daily Tiktoks using the platform. You can apply to join our content team HERE

What Makes Studley AI's AI Study Tool Unique?
+

Studley AI stands out by combining neuroscience-backed strategies with personalization. Our AI Study Tool transforms traditional studying into an interactive experience, ensuring you ace your exams while cutting your study time in half.

How Does the AI Study Tool Personalize My Learning?
+

Using advanced algorithms and evidence-based techniques, the AI Study Tool tailors quizzes, flashcards, written tests, fill in the blanks, and tutor lessons to your individual learning needs. This personalized approach ensures that every study session is optimized for your success.

Can the AI Study Tool Support Different Subjects and Exam Types?
+

Absolutely. Whether you're preparing for complex exams or need help with daily homework, our AI Study Tool adapts to various subjects and learning formats, providing clear, concise, and effective study materials for every need.

Is Studley AI Accessible on All My Devices?
+

Yes, the AI Study Tool is designed to work across multiple devices including desktops, tablets, and smartphones. This ensures that you have seamless access to your study materials anytime, anywhere, making studying truly convenient.

How Quickly Can I Expect to See Results?
+

Many students report noticeable improvements after incorporating our AI Study Tool into their routine. The blend of interactive quizzes, progress tracking, and personalized content means that you can start seeing benefits in just a few study sessions.

I have some unanswered questions. Who can I talk to?
+

Please email us at hello@studley.ai and we will respond to you within 24 hours.
